definition: Protecting AI systems and their inputs, models, tools and data from attacks and misuse.
details: AI security spans prompt injection, model theft, data poisoning, supply-chain risk and abuse of agents with access to real systems. Frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications catalog the most common failure modes and defenses.
story: Picture guardrails on a mountain road — not there to slow you down on the straightaways, but to keep you from flying off the cliff. Boil it down and it is this: Protecting AI systems and their inputs, models, tools and data from attacks and misuse. Here is why it matters: AI security spans prompt injection, model theft, data poisoning, supply-chain risk and abuse of agents with access to real systems. It is the difference between “it works” and “it is safe to put in front of people.” That deliberate caution is AI Security.

citation.title: OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications
